name: AttachmentGroup
label: Attachment group
description: The files on a sent message: one picture at its own shape, or a grid of tiles that collapses behind a count.

props.name: items
props.description: The files on the message, in order.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge the layout hugs: `end` for the sender's own turns.

props.name: max
props.description:
Most cells shown before the rest collapse. Over the limit, the last
cell becomes a "+N" button standing for the hidden files.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the overflow is expanded, for controlled use. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the overflow starts expanded, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the overflow expands or collapses.

props.name: viewer
props.description:
Open a pressed file in the built-in AttachmentViewer, which steps
through the rest of the group. Turn it off to handle presses yourself
through `onItemClick`.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Fires when a file is pressed, whether or not the viewer opens.

props.name: renderPreview
props.description: Passed to the viewer: draws a file it cannot, such as the pages of a PDF.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Passed to the viewer: fires when Download is pressed, and renders the buttons.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Passed to the viewer: fires when "Try again" is pressed on a file that failed to load.

props.name: size
props.description: Tile size, passed to every tile.

props.name: showMoreLabel
props.description: Builds the accessible label of the "+N" button from the hidden count.

props.name: showLessLabel
props.description: Text of the collapse button under an expanded group.

props.name: attachmentTileLabels
props.description: The status lines and progress name every tile writes, merged over the tile's English defaults ("Uploading…", "Upload failed", "Unavailable").

props.name: attachmentViewerLabels
props.description: The words the built-in viewer writes, merged over its English defaults: its buttons ("Download", "Close", "Previous file", "Next file", "Try again"), its fallback headlines and the position text ("2 of 5").

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale file sizes are written in, such as `de-DE` (`1,5 MB`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

AttachmentItem.description:
One attachment as the family passes it around: what a tile draws, what a
group lays out, and what `useAttachments` keeps. Plain data, so it
serialises and crosses the server boundary; the `File` itself stays with
whoever owns the upload.

AttachmentStatus.description: Where an attachment is in its life: usable, on its way, failed, or gone.
